mapper.select: SELECT /* LGSYSC00240.retrieveReviewRequestData */ request_master_id , request_code , approval_seqs , user_no , inspection_comment , approval_comment , NVL(share_flag,'N') AS use_flag , mandator_employee_no AS approver_user_no , approval_line_id AS attach_file_id FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N lasn WHERE request_master_id = #{requestId} AND request_code = #{requestCode} AND user_no = #{USER_SESSION.userName} AND approval_action_code = 'PREVIEW' AND approval_status_code = '2' AND mandator_employee_no = (SELECT b.user_no FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_N a , LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N b WHERE a.request_master_id = b.request_master_id AND a.request_code = b.request_code AND a.process_status_code = b.process_seq_no AND a.request_master_id = lasn.request_master_id AND a.request_code = lasn.request_code) /* 여러번 검토지정을 받았으면 선입선출로 처리한다. */ AND approval_seqs = (SELECT min(approval_seqs) FROM LGCOM_APPROVAL_STATUS_N asn WHERE request_master_id = lasn.request_master_id AND request_code = lasn.request_code AND user_no = lasn.user_no AND approval_action_code = lasn.approval_action_code AND approval_status_code = lasn.approval_status_code AND mandator_employee_no = lasn.mandator_employee_no)
